| A | **Production Date** | The day the lot was knitted. |

| D | **Machine Diameter (in)** | Diameter of the circular knitting machine, in inches. |
| E | **Machine Gauge (needles/in)** | Machine gauge, in needles per inch. |
| F | **Construction** | Knit structure, as a code. |

| J | **Fabric Diameter (in)** | Finished fabric diameter or width, in inches. |
| K | **GSM (g/m2)** | Fabric weight, in grams per square meter. |
| L | **Production Qty (kg)** | Amount knitted for this row, all shifts, in kilograms. |
| M | **Reject Qty** | Amount rejected; the unit isn't stated. |
